title: The Question about Fasting
description: Some ask Jesus why the disciples of John and the Pharisees fast, while his own disciples do not. Jesus answers with the image of the bridegroom: wedding guests cannot fast while the bridegroom is with them, but days will come when he is taken from them. He also uses the parables about a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment and new wine in old wineskins to show that the new requires new forms.
